channel.title: White Label Digital Twins on WLDT
channel.description: Recent content in White Label Digital Twins on WLDT

item.title: WLDT Library Version 0.7.0
item.description: Version 0.7.0 introduces the Augmentation Function framework, a major feature addition that extends Digital Twin capabilities beyond basic shadowing. This release adds a fully event-driven augmentation layer, comprehensive storage support for augmentation data, new event types on the WLDT Event Bus, and native augmentation-aware callbacks inside the DigitalTwinModel.

item.title: WLDT Library Version 0.6.0
item.description: Version 0.6.0 introduces a major architectural refactoring of the WLDT core framework alongside critical bug fixes and functional enhancements. This release focuses on improving semantic clarity, fixing data accessibility issues, and enhancing adapter capabilities.

item.title: CoAP Adapters Release
item.description: A new protocol is now supported in WLDT through the introduction of CoAP Adapters! The CoAP Digital and Physical Adapters enable seamless integration between Digital Twins and CoAP-based applications or physical assets.

item.title: WLDT Library Version 0.5.0
item.description: We’re excited to announce the release of WLDT version 0.5.0! This update is focused on two main areas: A Management Interface associated with the concept of Managed Resources, enabling better control and monitoring of resources within the WLDT ecosystem.

item.title: WLDT Library Version 0.4.0
item.description: We’re excited to announce the release of WLDT version 0.4.0! This update brings powerful new features to enhance your Digital Twin (DT) experience, including event observation capabilities, a robust storage layer, and a flexible query system.

item.title: WLDT Library Version 0.3.0
item.description: 📣 We’re thrilled to announce the release of version 0.3.0 of the White Label Digital Twins (WLDT) library! This release brings significant enhancements, improvements, and new features to further empower developers in designing, developing, and deploying Digital Twins within Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystems.

item.title: Physical Adapter
item.description: The developer can use an existing Physical Adapter or create a new one to handle the communication with a specific physical twin.
